+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from task_manager.app import create_app, init_db
+import tempfile
+import os
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def client_with_db():
+    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
+    os.close(fd)
+    init_db(path)
+    app = create_app(path)
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    yield client
+    if os.path.exists(path):
+        os.unlink(path)
+
+def test_health_endpoint_status_and_schema(client_with_db):
+    response = client_with_db.get("/healthz")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    data = response.json()
+    assert isinstance(data, dict)
+    assert data.get("status") == "ok"
+    assert data.get("app") == "mini-task-manager"
+    assert "version" in data
+
+def test_health_endpoint_repeated_calls_no_task_side_effect(client_with_db):
+    # Create initial tasks
+    t1 = client_with_db.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Task Alpha"}).json()
+    t2 = client_with_db.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Task Beta", "status": "in_progress"}).json()
+    
+    initial_tasks = client_with_db.get("/tasks").json()
+    
+    # Call GET /healthz repeatedly
+    for _ in range(10):
+        res = client_with_db.get("/healthz")
+        assert res.status_code == 200
+        assert res.json()["status"] == "ok"
+        
+    # Verify task data remains completely unmodified
+    after_tasks = client_with_db.get("/tasks").json()
+    assert after_tasks == initial_tasks
+    assert len(after_tasks) == 2
+    assert after_tasks[0]["title"] == "Task Alpha"
+    assert after_tasks[1]["title"] == "Task Beta"
